thread:
maria: FYI — after merging PR 0x4c9e (runtime/autotune) this morning, canary shows ~30% p50 regression on short-sequence workloads (<=128). Also seeing sudden GPU compile spikes on a couple hosts.
ajay: Grafana snapshot https://grafana/redwood/d/ohno/perf?panel=shortseqs — compile rate jumped ~5x at 09:12 UTC.
dev-ci-bot: CI perf-alert: job/runtime-bench-shortseqs exceeded threshold after merge 0x4c9e. Artifact: s3://redwood-ci/artifacts/1777777000/perf.json
sophie: Repro'd locally with the canary image, same perf hit. Profiling shows kernel cache hit-rate dropped from ~94% -> ~58% and lots of new compilations.
ajay: Can you paste the kernel key generation diff from the PR? I think there was a change around batching dims.
sophie: snippet: ```diff
-old_key = hash(model, layer_id, dtype, seq_len_group)
-new_key = hash(model, layer_id, dtype, exact_seq_len)
```
That change makes keys exact-by-seq_len; for short sequences it fragments reuse.
maria: That explains the compile storm — autotune now picks kernels by exact sequence length so we compile per-seq variants instead of reusing a bucketed kernel. The intent was better selection for long seqs but it regresses short seqs.
ajay: Two options: revert PR 0x4c9e immediately, or patch to quantize seq_len into buckets (e.g., 1-32,33-64,65-128). Which do we want as an emergency action?
sophie: Revert for immediate mitigation. Then follow-up: seq_len_buckets + unit tests to prevent key churn. I'll prepare both PRs.
maria: @ops-bot can you halt canary rollouts and revert to artifact 0x4c8f? We should block releases until perf stabilizes.
ops-bot: Initiating rollback to artifact 0x4c8f for canary group. Ingress frozen. Estimated rollback time ~6m.
dev-ci-bot: Also flagged: batch-splitter heuristic now splits incoming batches differently for short sequences after the same merge — might amplify the effect.
ajay: Sophie, please run a quick bisect across the PR commits to find the exact offending commit so we can cherry-pick a fix if needed.
sophie: Running git bisect on the PR branch now. Update: found offending commit 0x4c9e7a — commit message: "kernel: include exact seq_len in key". I'll open an immediate revert PR and a follow-up with seq_len bucketing + tests.
maria: Good catch. Also add a CI test that simulates a heavy stream of small batches to detect compile storms. Tagging eng-sre to watch GPU compile queue during rerun.
ajay: As a short-term guard, adding an env var fallback: `REDWOOD_KERNEL_KEY_LEGACY=1` to force old key format if compile rate > 3x baseline. Can we gate it behind a feature flag?
sophie: Drafted revert PR and a hotfix PR with an env var and seq_len quantization. Diff snippet in PR description. Requesting reviews.
maria: :thumbsup: After the rollback merged to canary we saw p50 return to baseline. Leaving this thread open until revert + tests merged to main. Will close once tests and hotfix land.
